power.neoorigins.class_lumberjack_starti: Faas bir ah oo aan jabin II.
origins.neoorigins.class_blacksmith.name: birtuur
origins.neoorigins.class_blacksmith.desc: Farsamoyaqaan xirfadle ah oo qalabkiisu tayadiisu sarreeyo, dayactirkiisuna uu yahay mid waxtar badan.
power.neoorigins.class_blacksmith_repair: Dayactirka anvil wuxuu ku kacayaa qiimo yar wuxuuna soo celinayaa adkeysi badan.
power.neoorigins.class_blacksmith_forge_: Gacmo qaawan ayaa dhagaxa u jejebiya sida jeex dhagax ah.
Waxyeelo kala badh ah ayay ka soo gaadhaa dabka, lafa-gaab, magma, iyo gubasho - maqaar qallafsan.
power.neoorigins.class_blacksmith_starti: Ku shub 4 xabo oo bir ah si loo bilaabo foorjada.
origins.neoorigins.class_cook.name: Karso
origins.neoorigins.class_cook.descriptio: Khabiir ku takhasusay cunnada oo cuntadiisa farsamaysan ay aad u nafaqo badan tahay oo sigaar cabista ka hela gunnada XP.
power.neoorigins.class_cook_food.name: Cunto Wanaagsan
power.neoorigins.class_cook_food.descrip: Cuntada aad farsamayso waxay ku siinaysaa gaajo gunno ah iyo dhereg.
power.neoorigins.class_cook_seasoned_pal: Saamaynta dawaynta kugu haysaa waxay ku sii dhamaanaysaa 25% in ka badan.
power.neoorigins.class_cook_knife.name: Mindida Cook
power.neoorigins.class_cook_knife.descri: Seef bir ah oo lagu dhasho - cunto kariye kastaa wuxuu u baahan yahay daab wanaagsan.
origins.neoorigins.class_merchant.name: Ganacsade
origins.neoorigins.class_merchant.descri: Ganacsade aqli badan oo dadka tuuladu ka ganacsadaan waligood ma dhammaan oo ka hela alaab naadir ah oo ay ka helaan ganacsatada wareegaysa.
power.neoorigins.class_merchant_rare_loo: Ganacsatada wareegaya waxay ku siinayaan ganacsiyo heer-sare ah iyo fursad aad ku hesho hanti naadir ah.
power.neoorigins.class_merchant_starting: Ku dhalaali sumurud si aad u abuurto ganacsigaagii ugu horreeyay.
power.neoorigins.class_merchant_silver_t: Saamaynta daawaynta ee kugu haysaa waxay ku sii dhamaanaysaa 15% - soo dhawayntu way raagtaa.
power.neoorigins.class_merchant_lucky_tr: +1 Nasiib - nasiib wanaag ayaa helay haggler wanaagsan.
origins.neoorigins.class_cleric.name: Wadaad
origins.neoorigins.class_cleric.descript: Aqoonyahan quduuska ah oo leh karti sixiran oo la xoojiyey iyo muddada dheriga oo la dheereeyey.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_enchanting: Miisaska xiisaha leh waxay ku siinayaan sixir ka wanaagsan agagaarkaaga.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_potions.de: Dhammaan waxyeelada dawaynta waxay qaadataa laba jeer in ka badan.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_turn_undea: Ku dhufashada aan dhiman waxay uga tagtaa iyagoo daciifay ilaa 4 ilbiriqsi.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_divine_sig: Si cad ayuu u arkaa iftiin hooseeya - hadiyad xagga sare ka timid.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_starting_b: Buug la qori karo oo duco iyo qoraal ah lagu soo shubay.
origins.neoorigins.class_nitwit.name: Nitwit
origins.neoorigins.class_nitwit.descript: Waxba si gaar ah uguma fiicna.Mararka qaarkood dariiqa ugu fudud ayaa ah midka saxda ah.
origins.neoorigins.class_fisher.name: Kalluumeysatada
origins.neoorigins.class_fisher.descript: Nolosha cidhifka biyaha - waxay ka soo jiidataa nasiib mawjadaha, waxay u dabaalataa sida shaabad oo kale, waxayna ku bilaabataa ul barakaysan.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_waters_luc: +1 Nasiib markaad biyaha ku jirto - mawjadda ayaa kuu roon.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_swim_speed: + 15% xawaaraha dhaqdhaqaaqa inta lagu jiro biyaha.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_sea_legs.d: Burburka badhkii qarqmay - sambabada oo bartay moolka.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_starting_r: Usha kalluumeysiga oo lagu xardhay Nasiibka Badda I iyo Lure I.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_night_sigh: Waxay kordhisaa aragga habeenkii marka ay biyaha hoostooda joogaan.
origins.neoorigins.class_mason.name: Mason
origins.neoorigins.class_mason.descripti: Dhagaxu waxa u soo saara gacmihii hore u shaqayn jiray - si dhakhso ah ayay u jebiyaa, calaacalaha la yaqaanna waxa ay hubiyaan jidhka, wax la soo qaadona had iyo jeer waa la gaadhi karaa.
power.neoorigins.class_mason_stone_hands: Gacmo qaawan ayaa dhagaxa u jejebiya sida jeex dhagax ah.
power.neoorigins.class_mason_strong_grip: + 1 hub dabiici ah oo laga soo bilaabo cimrigii oo la qabsaday la isticmaalay.
power.neoorigins.class_mason_starting_pi: Dhan leh waxtarka I dhagax pickaxe ah.
power.neoorigins.class_mason_block_reach: +1 meelaynta meelaynta oo la gaadho - cudud masonhu way taqaan halka darbigu ku dhamaado.
origins.neoorigins.class_paladin.name: Paladin
origins.neoorigins.class_paladin.descrip: Dagaalyahan quduuska ah - mid aan dhimanayn markuu taabto wuu qallalaa, engeguna ma qabsan karo, oo iftiinka iftiinka wuxuu bogsiiyaa nabarrada.
power.neoorigins.class_paladin_turn_unde: Ku dhufashada aan dhiman waxay uga tagtaa iyagoo daciifay ilaa 4 ilbiriqsi.
power.neoorigins.class_paladin_holy_armo: +2 hubka dabiiciga ah - iftiinka ayaa kaa ilaalinaya.
power.neoorigins.class_paladin_beacon_re: Si tartiib ah ayay dib u soo cusboonaataa iyadoo ku jirta 8 baloog ee nalka.
power.neoorigins.class_paladin_starting_: Smite I seef bir ah lagu dhalay.
power.neoorigins.class_paladin_effect_im: Kahortagga engega - nabarku kuma taaban karo.
origins.neoorigins.necromancer.name: Necromancer
origins.neoorigins.necromancer.descripti: Sayidka dhimashada oo amar ku bixiya kuwa aan dhimanin - qalfoofyada qallalan iyo qaansoleydu waxay ku dagaalamaan dhinacaaga, laakiin xooggaaga nolosha ayaa ku xidhan kooda.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_summon_with: U yeedha qalfoof engegan si uu kuugu dagaalamo.Max 2 hal mar.Waxay ku kacaysaa 6 nuxur.30-ilbiriqsi qaboojin.Waxa aad qaadanaysaa 1 dhaawac haddii uu ku dhinto dagaalka.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_summon_skel: U yeedh qaansole qalfoof ah si uu kuugu dagaalamo.Max 3 hal mar.Waxay ku kacaysaa 4 nuxur.20-ilbiriqsi qaboojin.Waxa aad qaadanaysaa 1 dhaawac haddii uu ku dhinto dagaalka.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_entity_grou: Lagu sifeeyay mid aan dhimanWaxyeeleeyey Caafimaadka degdega ah, waxaa bogsiiyey Burbur degdeg ah, oo ka difaaca Sunta.U nugul in la garaaco.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_water_breat: Uma baahna inuu neefsado.Wuxuu ku noolaan karaa ilaa xad aan xad lahayn.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_night_visio: Waxa uu si cad wax uga arki karaa gudcurka guud.Ku beddel furaha Aragga Habeenka (K)
power.neoorigins.necromancer_daylight_da: Waxay qaadataa 1.5 dhaawac ilbiriqsikii marka ay soo gaarto iftiinka qoraxda.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_reduced_hea: -3 wadnaha (-6 max HP).Jir dildillaac ka muuqdo.
Dib u soo kabashada caafimaadka dabiiciga ah ayaa hoos loo dhigay ilaa 40% ee caadiga ah.
origins.neoorigins.gorgon.name: Gorgon
origins.neoorigins.gorgon.description: Bahal-maqaar-dhagax leh oo indhahoodu soo jiidan karaan, oo feedhahooduna ay jajabaan - Laakiin miisaanka dhagaxa ayaa hoos u dhigaya tallaabo kasta.
Ku qaboojiya dhammaan cadawga u dhow oo leh gaabis V. Kharash 3 adkeysi ah.15-ilbiriqsi qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.gorgon_stone_fists.name: Feer dhagax
power.neoorigins.gorgon_stone_fists.desc: Waxay fulisaa 4 dhaawac dheeraad ah garaac kasta.
power.neoorigins.gorgon_granite_hide.des: Iska caabinta Joogtada ah I - maqaarka dhagaxa ayaa jilcisa saameyn kasta.
power.neoorigins.gorgon_heavy_frame.name: Mashxarad
power.neoorigins.gorgon_heavy_frame.desc: Dhaqdhaqaaqa 20% ka hooseeya sidii caadiga ahayd.
power.neoorigins.gorgon_size.name: Culayska Badan
power.neoorigins.gorgon_hunger_drain.des: 50% xawli ayuu u gubaa adkeysi - ilaalinta qaabka dhagaxa ayaa dareeraya.
origins.neoorigins.automaton.name: Iswada
origins.neoorigins.automaton.description: Dhisme makaanik ah oo aan waligii qarqin ama aan gaajoon - laakiin bogsashada potions-ka, soo kabashada dabiiciga ahi waa glacial, tallaabo kastana waa culus tahay.
power.neoorigins.automaton_iron_frame.de: Iska caabinta Joogtada ah I - jir adag oo birta ah ma nabarro.
power.neoorigins.automaton_no_drown.name: Chassis xiran
power.neoorigins.automaton_no_drown.desc: Uma baahna inuu neefsado.Ma qarqin karo
power.neoorigins.automaton_no_hunger.des: Waligaa ha gaajoon.Ku shaqeeya il koronto oo gudaha ah.
power.neoorigins.automaton_hide_hunger_b: Baarka gaajadu waa qarsoon yahay - automatons ma cunaan.
Barta hawadu waa qarsoon tahay - automatons ma neefsadaan.
power.neoorigins.automaton_potion_resist: Ka-hortagga dib-u-soo-noolaynta, caafimaadka degdegga ah, iyo sunta.Saamaynta dawooyinka kale ayaa wali jira.
Dareemayaasha indhaha ee ku dhex jira ayaa u oggolaanaya aragti cad oo mugdi ah.Ku beddel furaha Aragga Habeenka (K)
power.neoorigins.automaton_heavy_chassis: Dhaqdhaqaaqa 15% gaabis ah - jir culus, talaabooyin culus.
Bogsiinta dabiiciga ahi waxay ku socotaa heerka 25% - oo loo dhisay inay adkaysato, oo aan soo kabsanaynin.
power.neoorigins.automaton_knockback_res: 40% iska caabin dhabarka ah oo ka yimid miisaan badan.
origins.neoorigins.kraken.name: Kraken
origins.neoorigins.kraken.description: Ugaadh-badeed aad u weyn oo ku dhashay badweynta furan - biyaha hoostooda oo baaba'aya oo leh jeedal teendho ah, darbo khad ah, iyo mas'uuliyiin loo yeedhay, laakiin xeebta, gubtay, oo ku engegay dusha sare.
power.neoorigins.kraken_tentacle_lash.de: Dabaysa bolt hadh ah oo indho tira oo gaabiya dhammaan cadawga ku jira raadiyaha 6-block ah.Waxay ku kacaysaa 2 nuxur.6-labaad qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.kraken_ink_shot.name: Xabad khad
power.neoorigins.kraken_ink_shot.descrip: Dabayaa khad uruursan oo si weyn u gaabiya cadawga 5-block.Waxay ku kacaysaa 2 nuxur.8-labaad qaboojin.
Neefsashada biyaha hoostooda si aan xad lahayn oo si cad wax uga dhex arkaya biyaha iyada oo aan ceeryaamo lahayn.
